name: Benefit-led dashboard punch-in
description: Make one product action and its result concrete. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: You can supply a real before/action/after sequence from the product.

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: A close crop of your product screen and the step the user takes.

props.text: A screenshot cropped to the control or row that matters.

props.label: Outcome headline
props.placeholder: Close the month in one click
props.hint: Shows above the crop at the start.

props.subtitle: The same screen after the action, and where the result lives.

props.text: The same view after the action, with the result visible.

props.label: Context
props.placeholder: Right in your accounting dashboard, every month

props.subtitle: The result holds with one specific next step.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

value.title: Benefit-led dashboard punch-in
value.objective: Make one product action and its result concrete.
value.direction: The viewer sees one action and its result; a counter is optional and must carry a real, approved value.
beats: 0–1.8 s: Outcome headline appears above a zoomed crop. Shows Brand color, Product screen crop, Outcome headline.
1.8–4.3 s: Highlight the relevant control or row. Shows Brand color, Product screen crop, Action.
4.3–7.2 s: Replace or reveal the result state. Shows Brand color, Result screen, Result.
7.2–9.5 s: Pull back enough to show where the result lives. Shows Brand color, Product screen crop, Context.
9.5–12 s: Hold result plus a specific next action. Shows Brand color, Result screen, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Product screen crop
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Outcome headline appears above a zoomed crop. | Highlight the relevant control or row. | Pull back enough to show where the result lives.

images.label: Result screen
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Replace or reveal the result state. | Hold result plus a specific next action.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Hold result plus a specific next action.
